newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bankruptcies rise 9.6 pct in first 9-mths.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bankruptcies rise 9.6 pct in first 9-mths.

text.p: Commercial bankruptcies in Switzerland in the nine months to the end of September rose by 9.6 percent as compared to the same period of 1995.

Schweizerischer Verband Creditreform, a bureau which gives banks information on the creditworthiness of borrowers, said 3,128 commercial bankruptcy proceedings had been registered in the first nine months of the year compared with 2,854 in the same 1995 period.
Including non-firm bankruptcy proceedings, total bankruptcy cases rose 3.3 percent to 7,558 versus 7,314 last year. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
